The '''Garden of Equality''' was an open area that was positioned on the western side of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] [[Great Door of the Senate|Great Door]]. Adjacent to the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]] and opposite the [[Garden of Justice]], the gardens served as a restful area outside the bustle of the Senate's crowded corridors and debate halls.<ref name="TOR" />
